verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a terminal/SSH client app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any setting to opt out of them. Open-source and self-build mentions are adjacent and do not document a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
